language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hi, I'm Chip.
Hi, I am Wonton!
Today I am planning a party in my Castle in the Clouds. Will you help me prepare?
There are many activities to plan. We will have to group the items for these activities.
There are 24 gold coins.
Each person attending my party will be given gold coins.
If 4 people attend, how many coins will each person receive?
If you answered 6, you are correct!
Now, let’s plan for the rest of the party.

To prepare for the party I need to find the mass (or weight) of some of the party items. To determine the mass a scale will be used.
When the item has more mass than the other item on the scale, it will dip lower on the scale. When the mass is less it will be on the upside of the scale.
When the mass is the same the items will be level with each other.
